definition.description: Whether the patient is taking oxycodone.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if oxycodone is listed in the patient's medication list or documented as being used for pain management within the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the medication list is provided but oxycodone is not mentioned, represent as 'No'. If no medication information is provided in the record, represent as null.
definition.name: medication_oxycodone

definition.description: Whether the patient has previously received pemetrexed (Alimta) chemotherapy.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient's medical record indicates the administration of pemetrexed or Alimta, often found in chemotherapy regimens (e.g., 'cis-Alimta', 'cisplatin-pemetrexed').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'No' if there is no mention of the medication in the record.
definition.name: medication_pemetrexed

definition.description: Presence of thickening of the meninges as identified on neuroimaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether meningeal thickening is reported as present or absent within the extra-axial structures or impression section of the pretreatment neuroimaging reports.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the report does not mention the meninges or if the status is described ambiguously.
definition.name: meningeal_thickening

definition.description: The amplification status of the MET gene in tumor tissue.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the MET amplification status from the molecular profiling or NGS report. Classify as 'Amplified' if the report indicates 'amplified', 'gain', or a high copy number; classify as 'Negative' if the report indicates 'not detected', 'wild-type', or no amplification.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if MET amplification status or copy number is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: met_amplification_status

definition.description: Patient-level assessment of whether there was a metabolic response to treatment, typically determined by functional imaging.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the presence or absence of a documented metabolic response to therapy (e.g., via PET scan) from the pretreatment or treatment-monitoring records.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no information regarding metabolic response is documented.
definition.name: metabolic_response

definition.description: The anatomical location of metastatic disease in a patient.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify the anatomical sites of distant metastasis as documented in radiology reports (such as CT, MRI, or PET scans) or oncology assessment notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no metastatic locations are documented or if the patient is explicitly noted to have no distant metastases.
definition.name: metastasis_location

definition.description: Whether the patient was administered morphine prior to treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract 'Yes' if the patient record indicates the use or administration of morphine (e.g., for pain control); otherwise extract 'No'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if morphine administration is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: morphine_administered

definition.description: Presence of hyperintensity on T2-FLAIR MRI sequences.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient's medical records, specifically MRI reports, indicate the presence or absence of T2-FLAIR hyperintensities.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no documentation regarding T2-FLAIR hyperintensity is found in the patient record.
definition.name: mri_flair_hyperintensity_presence

definition.description: Microsatellite instability (MSI) status of the tumor.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the MSI status from the molecular pathology or Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) report. Values such as 'Stable', 'MSS', 'Microsatellite Stable' map to 'Stable'; values such as 'High', 'MSI-H', 'MSI-High' map to 'High'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if MSI status is not documented or the result is ambiguous.
definition.name: msi_status

definition.description: Presence of mucositis (inflammation and ulceration of the mucous membranes) prior to treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether mucositis is documented as being present or absent in the pretreatment clinical records.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the clinical records do not explicitly mention the presence or absence of mucositis.
definition.name: mucositis_presence

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
